items.title: AlterContacts
items.source_text: AlterContacts AI client relationship assistant that thinks and does ahead AlterContacts is a voice-first AI assistant that helps you remember every client and never miss an important follow-up. Just talk about your meeting, and Alter organizes the details, updates the client's profile, and remembers what you promised. It notices upcoming renewals, personal milestones, and relationships that need attention, then prepares your next message for approval. Built for financial advisors, brokers, and consultants who care about relationships, not CRM data entry. Artificial Intelligence Virtual Assistants CRM

items.title: AI Context Flow MCP
items.source_text: AI Context Flow MCP Memory you control, synced to every agent, tool and team Ten AI tools, ten partial memories, all drifting apart, with no record of who changed what. AI Context Flow fixes that with one shared memory over MCP. Save a client brief in Claude, and tomorrow your ChatGPT, Grok Bot and your teammate’s Cursor all work from the same version. Organize memory into buckets by project or client, choose who can access each one, and see every edit in full version history. If an agent overwrites something, roll it back. Productivity Storage Artificial Intelligence

items.title: Rankhog
items.source_text: Rankhog Get customers from Reddit on autopilot Rankhog finds people on Reddit asking for what you sell. It reads each subreddit's rules, writes a reply that helps, and posts it from your own account at a human pace. Say yes to each reply, or turn on autopilot. No Reddit account? Rankhog warms up a new one, and you own it. Run it from the app, or from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client. 7 days free. Marketing Artificial Intelligence reddit

items.title: Yoroll
items.source_text: Yoroll Build playable stories without a game engine Yoroll lets anyone turn stories into playable, cinematic games without coding or a game engine. Start with a script, image, or video clip, then direct the scenes, add player choices, and create branching storylines with different outcomes. AI helps bring everything together into an interactive experience you can share. It's more like directing your own interactive movie than programming a game. Artificial Intelligence Games No-Code
